state_semantics.EXECUTED: requires an independently authorized execution and completion receipt
state_semantics.PLANNED: declared by the draft protocol but no complete registered fit plan exists
state_semantics.REGISTERED: logical cell and fit-plan rows are registered; this does not mean run
state_semantics.WITHDRAWN: historical scope is retained only for forensic exclusion

withdrawn_forensic_scope.reason: withdrawn pending an observed-lineage rerun under a future authority

explicitly_excluded_or_degraded: withdrawn corrected historical 432-cell information ladder: EXCLUDED
cohort, novelty, and audit extensions: ABSENT_UNRUN
any scope requiring an absent production loader, trainer, scorer, or writer: BLOCKED
